package.name: occupancy_inflation
package.description: Obstacle inflation for online planning: subscribes to a PointCloud2, voxelises it into a dense bitset, dilates the occupied voxels with word parallel morphology and republishes the result. Accumulates across messages so a map that keeps growing only costs what it adds. No PCL dependency: point clouds are read and written through include/occupancy_inflation/eigen_conversions.h.
